description: This file defines the IdSpanCodec class responsible for serializing and deserializing IdSpan instances within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for writing and reading IdSpan data to and from buffers, both with and without field framing, and references external serialization components.

classes.name: IdSpanCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for IdSpan, providing methods for serializing and deserializing IdSpan instances.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an IdSpan value into a buffer with field framing, including type information and length prefix.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes an IdSpan value into a buffer without field framing, writing length, hash code, and bytes.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Deserializes an IdSpan value from a buffer without field framing, reading length, hash code, and payload bytes.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes an IdSpan value from a buffer with field framing, ensuring wire type and reading length, hash code, and payload bytes.
